day_local: Xuska Quduus Hieronymus, Wadaad iyo Bare Kaniisadeed
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Aamiin. Nabadgelyada iyo naxariista Ilaah ha idinla joogaan maanta oo dhan.
penitential:
Sayidow, naxariiso. Sayidow, naxariiso.
Masiixo, naxariiso. Masiixo, naxariiso.
Sayidow, naxariiso. Sayidow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Ducadaydu ha kor u timaado adiga hortaada, Sayidow.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kacdo ee aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay culus tahay, sidii iyadoo ereyadu ay aad u yar yihiin si ay u qaadaan culayska qalbiga ku jira. Waxaan maanta eegaynaa sawir yar oo ka mid ah nolosha qoyskaaga. Waxaan arkaa Benjamin Vo oo fadhiya inta u dhaxeysa safarrada, isagoo gacanta ku haya qof yar oo qoyska ka mid ah, si taxaddar leh oo jilicsan ugu haya dusha sare ee iftiinka xadhkaha ah ee guriga dibaddiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo dejiyo wax walba oo hareerihiisa ah. Maskaxdiisu waxay ahayd mid shaqaynaysa oo dhisaysa fikrado waaweyn, sida diyaaradaha 'Con Chim Airlines' ee uu ku gigin jiray markuu ka hadlayo, laakiin qalbigiisuna wuxuu ahaa mid deggan oo naxariis leh. Saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii uu Ben u gudbay nolosha kale, waxaana ogahay in guriga dhexdiisa uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid aamusan, sidii in meel bannaan ay jirto oo aan la buuxin karin.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Job, wuxuu inoo keenayaa su'aal qoto dheer oo ay tahay inaan wajihiro. Job wuxuu la hadlayaa saaxiibbadiis, wuxuuna leeyahay: 'Sidee buu nin u noqon karaa mid xaq ah Ilaah horteed?' Job wuxuu ka hadlayaa weynaanta Ilaah ee aan la koobi karin. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Wuxuu dhaqaajiyaa buuraha inta aysan ogaan; wuxuu ridaa dhulka meesha uu ka taagnaa.' Waxaan ku dhex jirnaa adduun ay awoodaha nolosha iyo dhimashadu ay ka weyn yihiin fahamkeenna bini'aadamka. Markaad akhrineyso erayada Job, waxaad dareemeysaa inuu qof walba is-weydiinayo sababta uu dhibku u yimaado, sababta ay wakhtiyadu u noqdaan kuwo sidaan oo kale u adag.

Laakiin waxaa jira meel aan kaga gudubno su'aashaas oo aan u nimaadno Injiilka maanta. Injiilka Luukas wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheekooyin gaagaaban oo ku saabsan raacitaanka Ciise. Qof ayaa u yimid oo yiri: 'Waan ku raaci doonaa meel kasta oo aad tagto.' Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay: 'Dawacooyinku waxay leeyihiin godad, shimbiraha cirkuna waxay leeyihiin buulal, laakiin Wiilka Aadanaha meel uu madaxa saaro ma leh.' Ka dibna mid kalena wuxuu yiri: 'Sayidow, ii oggolow inaan horta aado oo aan aaso aabbahaa.' Ciise wuxuu ku yiri: 'U daa kuwa dhintay inay aasaan kuwii dhintay; laakiin adigu tag oo ku wacdi Boqortooyada Ilaah.' Iyo mid saddexaad oo yiri: 'Waan ku raaci doonaa, Sayidow, laakiin horta ii oggolow inaan sagootiyo reerkayga guriga.' Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay: 'Qof walba oo gacanta saara taambuugga oo dib u eegaya waxa ka dambeeya ma u qalmo Boqortooyada Ilaah.'

Maxay erayadani uga dhigan yihiin adiga maanta? Ciise ma leh inaanan jeclayn qoyskeenna ama inaanan xasuusan wixii tagay. Maya. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaysan jirin waqti dib loogu eego cabsi iyo qoomamo. Wuxuu rabaa inaan horay u socono iyadoo qalbigaagu uu buuxo rajo. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben, ama marka aad xasuusato codkiisii jilicsanaa ee dhahaya 'Good morning, Dad,' aad dareemaysaan culeys weyn. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aan si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa.

Waxaan xusuustaa sheekada uu Ben sameeyay markuu ahaa shan iyo toban jirka. Markii adeerkiis William uu la halgamnayey xanuunka, Ben, oo aan cidina ku amrin, wuxuu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu bixiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay, in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso, iyo xasuusyada aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, halkaas oo uu ku sugan yahay adoo dhoola caddaynaya. Jacaylka Ben wuxuu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, in lagu xisaabiyo nalka iyo nabadda Masiixu, aan tukanno.
Dadka oo dhan ee la halgamaya murugada iyo xanuunka, in Ilaah siiyo qaboojin iyo rajo aan dhammaad lahayn, aan tukanno.
communion: Ciisow, waa ogahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sakramenti Barakeysan ee Meesha Allabariga. Waan jecelahay wax walba, waxaana u oomanahay inaan kugula midoobo naftayda. Maaddaama aanan hadda heli karin Sakramenti ahaan, fadlan igu soo gal xagga ruuxa qalbigayga. Waxaan ku aqoonsanahay inaad joogto, waxaana isku dhiibayaa adiga gebi ahaanba; ha ii oggolaanin inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Barakada Ilaaha Qaadirka ah, Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah, ha dul degto idinka iyo kuwa aad jeceshahay oo ha la joogto maanta iyo weligeedba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, in ay ku nastaan iftiinka Masiixa.
Dadka oo dhan ee murugaysan, in Ilaah qaboojiyo qalbiyadooda oo siiyo rajo.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Job wuxuu u jawaabay saaxiibbadiis, wuxuuna yiri: Waan ogahay in ay sidaas tahay; laakiin sidee buu nin u noqon karaa mid xaq ah Ilaah horteed? Haddii qof uu rabo inuu la doodo isaga, ugama jawaabi karo kun jeer hal jeer. Ilaah waa caqli badan yahay oo xoog weyn; waa ayee kan la dagaalamay oo ka baxsaday isagoo aan dhaawacmin? Wuxuu saaraa buuraha inta aysan oogan; wuxuu ku rogaa cadhadiisa. Wuxuu ruxaa dhulka meesha uu ka taagnaa, tiirarkuna way gariiraan. Wuxuu amraa qorraxda, mana soo baxdo; wuxuu xidhaa xiddigaha. Isaga kaliya ayaa kala bixiya samada oo ku socda gidaarka badda. Wuxuu sameeyay Orion iyo Ursa, iyo xiddigaha koonfureed; wuxuu sameeyaa waxyaabo waaweyn oo aan la baadhi karin, iyo waxyaabo la yaab leh oo aan la tirin karin. Haddii uu ii dhowaado, ma arko; haddii uu dhaafo, ma ogaado. Haddii uu iga qabsado xoog, waa ayee ku dhici karta inuu yiraahdo 'Maxaad samaynaysaa?' Sidee baan ugu jawaabi karaa, ama dood uga keenay xaggiisa? Xitaa haddii aan xaq ahayn, ugama jawaabi lahaa, laakiin waxaan baryi lahaa wixii aan xaq u lahaa. Haddii aan u yeedho oo uu igu jawaabo, ma rumaysan lahaa inuu maqlay eraygayga.

readings.label: Sabuurka Jawaabta
readings.text: R. Ducadaydu ha kor u timaado adiga hortaada, Sayidow. Maalin walba waan kuu yeedhaa, Sayidow; gacmahoodaan adiga kuu soo taagayaa. Miyuu la yaab u samayn doonaa kuwa dhintay? Miyay kuwii dhintay kici doonaan si ay kuugu mahadceliyaan? R. Ducadaydu ha kor u timaado adiga hortaada, Sayidow. Miyay ku dhawaaqaan naxariistaada xabaasha dhexdeeda, iyo daacadnimadaada kuwa hallowday? Miyay la yaabkaagu ka muuqdaan gudcurka, ama caddaaladdu dalka illowshaha? R. Ducadaydu ha kor u timaado adiga hortaada, Sayidow. Laakiin anna, Sayidow, waan kuu qayliyaa; ducadayda subaxnimada ayaan ku sugayaa. Sayidow, maxaad ii diidaysaa, maxaadse iiga qarinaysaa wejigaaga? R. Ducadaydu ha kor u timaado adiga hortaada, Sayidow.

day: Memorial of Saint Jerome, Priest and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
